retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban lifestyle composition featuring a vibrant luxury vehicle parked in front of a white suburban house with a central human subject and ground-level graffiti-style lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle, low-perspective photograph of a man standing next to an open-door orange sports car on a residential street, with a two-story white house and a group of people in the background, anchored by a red spray-paint style signature on the pavement.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant orange car contrasting against a neutral white house
Human subject in the foreground balanced by a group on the porch
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the car's scale
Red gestural lettering on the ground acting as a foreground anchor
coreInvariants: The presence of a high-saturation orange vehicle as the primary color pop
A white-sided suburban house with black shutters as the backdrop
A low-angle camera position near the asphalt level

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject stands mid-right, leaning on a large orange car that occupies the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange car and the red signature on the asphalt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the red signature in the bottom left, across the car to the subject, then up to the house and the group on the stairs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky and the upper white siding of the house provide neutral breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and neutral grays from the house and asphalt.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks from the shutters, clothing, and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a desaturated, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or pastel tones for the car
Keep the house siding strictly neutral white

letterConstructionRules: Continuous, fluid strokes with varying pressure
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated tails on the first and last letters to frame the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast the organic, messy script with a clean, sans-serif advisory block in the corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the hand-drawn feel on asphalt

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a man in a black shirt and jeans standing next to an orange Lamborghini with the door open, parked in front of a white two-story suburban house with people on the porch.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, red, gestural spray-paint style signature on the asphalt in the bottom left corner, following the ground's perspective.

verificationChecks: Is the car a vibrant, high-saturation orange?
Is the signature perspective-aligned to the street?
Is the house white with black shutters?
Is the camera angle low to the ground?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of background people

mustAchieve: Realistic lighting integration between car and environment
Authentic spray-paint texture for the lettering
Sharp focus on the foreground subject
avoid: Floating text that doesn't sit on the ground

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange car is the primary visual focus.
Ensure the red signature looks like it is painted on the road.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the house provides a clean, neutral backdrop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Lifestyle + Luxury Vehicle + Suburban Backdrop + Ground-Level Tagging
